scope: selected RTL decoder semantic modes; parameter domains listed but not exhaustively qualified

parameter_domains.mreg_0_63: physical tensor register index; BF16 and FP8 views alias the same file
parameter_domains.bf16_even_pair_0_62: even base of two adjacent physical tensor registers
parameter_domains.mxu_unit_0_1: distinct MXU0 systolic and MXU1 inner-product-tree units
parameter_domains.mxu_local_slot_0_1: local slot scoped to owning MXU
parameter_domains.raw_imm16: raw 16-bit immediate; VLI mode determines destination extent
parameter_domains.e8m0_scale_reg_0_31: scalar scale-register selector, not an admitted quantization scheme
parameter_domains.signed_pc_relative_or_indirect: branch/JAL encoded byte displacement interpreted by selected PC; JALR dynamic target
parameter_domains.e8m0_code_0_255: raw E8M0 byte loaded through SELI; no operand scaling scheme inferred
